eyebrow: The one equation behind every permission
code:
Role assignment =
  Security principal   (who)
  + Role definition     (what)
  + Scope                (where)
caption: Change any one of the three and you have a different role assignment.

eyebrow: Three built-in roles you'll use constantly

steps.label: Owner
steps.sub: Full access, plus the power to grant access to others

steps.label: Contributor
steps.sub: Full access to manage resources, cannot grant access

steps.label: Reader
steps.sub: Can view everything, can change nothing

steps.label: Mgmt Group
steps.sub: Applies to every subscription underneath it

steps.label: Subscription
steps.sub: Applies to every resource group underneath it

steps.label: Resource Group
steps.sub: Applies to every resource underneath it

steps.label: Resource
steps.sub: Applies to that one resource only

code:
Instead of:
  Alex = Owner @ subscription

Grant:
  Alex = Contributor @ rg-finance-app
caption: The narrowest role, at the narrowest scope, that still gets the job done.
